plan: Since this is a one-round auction and my value is $7, I should bid slightly above my value to maximize potential profit while minimizing loss. Given the rationality of bidders, they would not bid above their value. Thus, I will bid $7.1 to potentially win if others bid below or at their value. This ensures that if I win, I pay a minimal amount close to my value, maximizing my profit.

Given my private value of $18, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. This bid is close enough to my value to be competitive but also ensures that if others bid close to their value, I have a chance to win while minimizing potential losses.

Given my value of $44, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction at a cost below $44. To avoid overbidding and risking negative profit, I'll bid slightly above the expected average bid.
